question.en: After software updates, our customers report significant ______ in both speed and reliability.

question.en: Employees can take up to two weeks off at a time as long as ______ requests are approved in advance.

options.vi: themselves (Đại từ phản thân): chính họ

question.en: Service representatives are responsible for being the ______contact for each of our clients.
question.vi: Các đại diện dịch vụ có trách nhiệm là người liên lạc chính cho mỗi khách hàng của chúng tôi.

question.en: The ______ of the fund-raiser was due to bad weather, so the event will be rescheduled for next weekend.

question.en: AVB Education’s online courses help users master many computer skills more ______ than other learning methods do.

question.en: The ______ of several celebrities at the Sasaki Museum attracted local residents seeking photographs.

options.vi: presence (N): sự hiện diện, sự có mặt
presentable (Adj): chỉnh tề, đáng trình bày

question.en: The committee enthusiastically ______ the theater company’s grant application because it encourages community participation.

question.en: Aryxco’s shipping costs vary based upon the destination and the weight ______ the package.

question.en: The health records of our clients are stored on a ______ server that is accessible only to authorized users.
question.vi: Hồ sơ sức khỏe của khách hàng chúng tôi được lưu trữ trên một máy chủ bảo mật mà chỉ những người dùng được ủy quyền mới có thể truy cập.

question.en: Before we sign a contract with the heating company, we must confirm that its proposal meets our installation ______.

question.en: The area ______ the new Furniture Vine headquarters is covered by dense forest.
question.vi: Khu vực bao quanh trụ sở mới của Furniture Vine được bao phủ bởi rừng rậm.

question.en: The firm’s top analysts expect that the acquisition of Valuwest, Inc., will lead to a ______future for shareholders.

question.en: Upon reviewing the draft of the agreement, the lead lawyer will notify Ms. Gwan’s team ______ any concerns.

options.vi: regarding (Prep): về việc, liên quan đến

question.en: Following a two-year break, the Grear Institute is once again ______ career-building workshops for health-pare workers.

question.en: Operating hours of Big Midwest Cafes are subject to local ______ enforced by the city in which the cafe is located.
question.vi: Giờ hoạt động của các quán cà phê Big Midwest phụ thuộc vào các quy định địa phương do thành phố nơi quán tọa lạc thực thi.

question.en: The legal department ______revisions to the amendment last week, and Ms. Koehler sent it to the corporate group for review.

question.en: Ms. Arriata asked all ______in yesterday's Productivity and Technology workshop to send in their questionnaires.

question.en: With bicycling becoming more popular than ever, the city council plans to ______ the number of bicycle lanes on city streets.

question.en: Claston Industry’s guidelines help ensure that equipment ordered from all suppliers ______ safety standards.

options.vi: was met (Bị động): đã được đáp ứng

question.en: Though Ms. Daiyu ______ handles customer inquiries, Mr. Mei takes over when she gets, a special assignment from her manager.

question.en: Although unforeseen factors initially ______ the construction of the wind farm, it opened on schedule.

options.vi: are complicating (V-ing): đang gây rắc rối
be complicated (V-passive): bị làm cho rắc rối

question.en: ______ Haruto sees an opportunity for professional development, he is sure to take advantage of it.
question.vi: Bất cứ khi nào Haruto thấy một cơ hội để phát triển chuyên môn, anh ấy chắc chắn sẽ tận dụng nó.
